MainView

class MainView(parent=None)[source]

Bases: QMainWindow, Ui_MainView, WindowConfig

Main window: menus, game actions and status bar.

Parameters:
parentQWidget | None, optional

Parent widget. Default is None.

Attributes:
controllerMainController

Controller of the window.

msgMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

status_timerQTimer

Updates the status bar every second.

Notes

The games are discovered with ViewFactory.discover_games(), and each entry of a game’s menu_actions becomes an action in the exergames settings submenu (label and icon from the metadata).

Methods

closeEvent

Stop the status timer and close if the user confirms.

setup_status_bar

Show the status bar and start its one-second update timer.

show_critical_error

Show a critical error dialog.

update_status_info_time

Show the platform version, date and time in the status bar.

update_status_message

Show a temporary message in the status bar.
setup_status_bar()[source]

Show the status bar and start its one-second update timer.

update_status_info_time()[source]

Show the platform version, date and time in the status bar.

Notes

The texts are translated with self.tr() and the date and time use the configured masks. A new QStatusBar with a new label replaces the previous one on every call.

update_status_message(message, timeout=6000)[source]

Show a temporary message in the status bar.

Parameters:
messagestr

Message to show.

timeoutint, optional

Time in milliseconds. Default is 6000.

show_critical_error(title, text)[source]

Show a critical error dialog.

Parameters:
titlestr

Dialog title.

textstr

Error message.

closeEvent(event)[source]

Stop the status timer and close if the user confirms.

Parameters:
eventQCloseEvent

Close event; ignored if the user cancels the exit.

Notes

The timer is stopped even when the user cancels, so the clock in the status bar stops updating.
